doc: Every float32 bin edge k / 10 exactly, one float32 ulp below and one above it, plus values outside [0, 1] (-0.1, 1.1, -1e30, 1e30), which are dropped (the histogram is renormalized by what is left). The edge value goes to the upper bin and 1.0 to the last: np.histogram bins [edge_k, edge_k+1), the last bin closed, edges = linspace(0, 1, bins + 1) computed in float64 (k * (1 / bins)) and rounded to the IMAGE dtype (float32 edges for a float32 image); values outside [0, 1] are dropped; weights cos(lat) in float64, normalized by their sum. Float64 sums of weights: 1e-9.
